name: Soft wall rally
summary: Solo against a wall: soft forehand and backhand hits at dink pace, then gentle volleys, counting a streak.
setup: Stand about 2-3 m from a flat wall; optional tape line about 1 m high as a net
Minutes 1-3: soft forehands with one bounce; minutes 4-6: soft backhands; last minutes: gentle volleys without a bounce
success_criterion: One streak of 30 consecutive controlled hits without the ball bouncing twice
safety_notes: Keep the ball soft and below head height. Stop if in pain.
coach_rationale: (judgment) A soft, repetitive contact against a wall grooves paddle-face control at low intensity; counting a streak gives a numeric warm-up target. Unverified coaching content until a human coach reviews the library (P15).
